title: The Last Sunrise
plot_overview: A college student living with a chronic illness travels to Mallorca with her mother for the summer. There, she falls for a local and starts embracing the present, but worsening health and buried family secrets threaten the life and romance she has begun to build.
will_you_like_this: You may enjoy this if you like sentimental summer romances, scenic escapes, and emotionally direct stories; Not for you if you want surprises, substantial drama, or a less formulaic experience.
review_summary: Pros: appealing Mallorca setting; vulnerable lead performance; romantic atmosphere | Cons: predictable story; formulaic drama; uneven performances
